en: A colorized vintage panorama showing a colonial-era town with low houses and red-tiled roofs scattered over rolling terrain. A main avenue runs through the settlement, with small trees, dirt roads, and scattered buildings typical of early 20th‑century urban development. At the top of the image, red printed text identifies the location as Loanda and specifies the Mutamba neighborhood and Avenida Álvaro Ferreira.
